title: Stow a footrest with its index latch
context: Clearing an empty footrest from a transfer space is useful when preparing an assistive device. The training module requires a separate hand to withdraw its latch before the footrest can swing. No person or occupant is present.
scoring: The latch must first retract at least 25 mm. If the footrest rotates beyond 8 degrees before this happens the entire episode scores zero. Correct latch retraction earns 0.25. After that a footrest angle from 87 degrees to 92 degrees earns 0.5. Latch travel at most 3 mm with angular speed below 0.03 radians per second raises this to 0.75. Both measured grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. At this angle the footplate clears the yellow transfer region by at least 10 mm. All other outcomes score zero.
fidelity: This is an unoccupied tabletop training module. The footrest has a passive revolute joint with a 90 degree stop. The index wheel and spring pin have separate articulation roots so contact physically blocks the initial swing until the pin is withdrawn. The spring stiffness is 40 newtons per metre with damping 0.8 and maximum force 2 newtons. The module uses printed polymer solids. There is no human load or clinical suitability claim.
instruction: Stow the footrest module so the marked transfer space is clear. Pull the grey latch back and hold it while swinging the blue footrest through 90 degrees. Return the latch into the second index slot. Release both handles. The module is unoccupied and unpowered.
setup: Use the bimanual YAM station with the tabletop at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. Every part is printed PA12 polymer. scene_inventory.json lists every object and every solid with exact dimensions and initial positions in metres and masses in kilograms. Object positions use the world frame. Solid positions use their body frame. Joint anchors and limits are listed with the articulated object. The setup image shows this fixed layout. All joint positions start at zero.
run_limit: 600 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 30 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
scores: Both uploaded videos show the same scripted demo with score 1.0. No model score is claimed.
